category_title: Students with visual impairments who use floor-sitting and screaming as task avoidance
minimal_context: The O&M instructor is picking up the student from the classroom to initiate an O&M lesson.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time for your O&M lesson. Please rise up from your chair.

STUDENT: (Begins to scream and cry, and will not stand up)

TUTOR: We need to leave the classroom now. Let's go.

STUDENT: (Immediately drops to the floor and starts screaming)

TUTOR: (Picks the child up and holds him while physically prompting him to walk) You need to walk.

STUDENT: (Screams, cries, drops to the floor, and refuses to stand or walk)

options.A: Extend O&M lessons to one and a half hours, unlike standard sessions which last 40-50 minutes.
options.B: Develop a chart that lists the date, time, setting, antecedent, behavior, consequence, and function of the behavior.
options.C: Put effort into improving the student's transition technique and increasing their ability to take initiative.
options.D: Provide extra time to complete the transition to the O&M lesson, allowing flexibility with timelines.
